production.text:
List run events
Copy page

List stored Agent run events or replay them as server-sent events.

GET
/
agent
/
runs
/
{id}
/
events
Try it
By default, this endpoint returns a paginated JSON list of stored events. Set Accept: text/event-stream to replay stored events as SSE. For JSON pagination, use cursor. For SSE replay, use Last-Event-ID.
Get your Exa API key
Create a key in the dashboard. New accounts start with free credits.
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Headers
​
Accept
enum<string>

Set to text/event-stream to receive server-sent events.

Available options: application/json, text/event-stream 
​
Last-Event-ID
string

For SSE replay, return only events after this event ID.

Path Parameters
​
id
stringrequired

Agent run ID.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

Query Parameters
​
limit
integerdefault:20

Number of results per page

Required range: 1 <= x <= 100
​
cursor
string

Cursor for pagination. Use the nextCursor value from the previous event list response.

Response
200
application/json

Agent run events

​
object
stringrequired
Allowed value: "list"
​
data
object[]required

Show child attributes

​
hasMore
booleanrequired

Whether there are more results

​
nextCursor
string | nullrequired
